title: Taste or Strategy? Nationalistic Bias and Competitor Penalties in Figure Skating Judging
abstract: arXiv:2611.13194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many decisions rest on expert panels whose members have ties to some candidates, and favoritism is hard to tell from shared taste or better information. Using a rich dataset from figure skating, we find evidence of a strategic compatriot premium and a targeted penalty on the compatriot's close rivals. The premium falls along a randomly drawn start order and, before 2022/23, rises when close rivals have their own judges on the panel. The penalty grows with the compatriot's placement chances and fades once she is out of contention. A counterfactual analysis shows that these biases can shape close competitions.

translated_title: 品味还是策略？花样滑冰裁判中的民族主义偏见与对竞争对手的惩罚
translated_abstract: 许多决策依赖于专家小组，其成员往往与某些候选人存在关联，而这种偏袒行为很难与共同的品味偏好或更充分的信息区分开来。利用来自花样滑冰的丰富数据集，我们发现了策略性“同胞溢价”的证据，即裁判偏袒本国选手，同时对同胞选手的主要竞争对手进行针对性惩罚。这一溢价随着随机抽取的出场顺序而下降，并且在2022/23赛季之前，当主要竞争对手的评审团中也有本国裁判时，溢价会进一步上升。惩罚程度则随着同胞选手的排名机会增大而增强，一旦她失去竞争希望，惩罚便会消失。反事实分析表明，这些偏见足以影响势均力敌的比赛结果。
tldr: 研究利用花样滑冰评分数据证实裁判存在策略性偏袒本国选手的“同胞溢价”以及对其主要竞争对手的针对性惩罚，且这种偏见足以左右势均力敌的比赛结果。
en_tdlr: Using figure skating scoring data, this study reveals a strategic compatriot premium and a targeted penalty on close rivals by nationalistic judges, showing these biases can decide close competitions.
